newsitem.title: USA: Venezuela seeks to offer U.S. extra heating oil.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela seeks to offer U.S. extra heating oil.

text.p: Venezuela is looking for ways to produce an extra 20,000-30,000 barrels per day of heating oil for the U.S. market, said Luis Giusti, president and CEO of Petroleos de Venezuela SA.

"We are looking into marginal production...(to produce) 20,000 to 30,000 barrels per day additional heating oil," he said at a luncheon hosted by the Johns Hopkins School of Advanced International Studies.

Guisti repeated comments he made earlier in the week that Venezuela did not have much flexibility in its refineries to produce more than the 150,000 bpd of heating oil that it is already sending to the United States.
He said he should know soon whether they can produce an extra 30,000 bpd "with the purpose of trying to respond to this request."
The U.S. Energy Department last week approached Venezuela for help to bolster U.S. stocks of heating oil ahead of this winter.
